quest.6F25B3D78143ED1E.quest_desc: This could be more compacted but i think you get the idea.
- Make 2 &ebees&r with max genes, then start making babies non-stop.
- Send those &ebabies&r to the incubator, which return &eadult&r bees.
- Then send those bees to the &adispenser&r and crush them with a &dpiston&r. Piston can be always on.
- You need a &cwireless&r item collector, like &aFunctional Drawer&r or &bModular Routers&r, to get the bottle with the bee.
- Send that bottle to a &6centrifuge&r and the result to an indexer with a redstone signal.
You want to store all genes except the one that changes the bee type, which has text in orange or says &6productivebees:<something here>&r.
Also, make sure you have &apower&r in your machines. See next &2page&r.
